# Phase 9 property test report

**Command:** `cargo test -p reak-progression --test prg_proptest`

## Property

**Classification determinism:** For arbitrary valid-style inputs generated by proptest, calling `classify_only` twice yields the same `ProgressionState` and does not error when the first call succeeds.

## Implementation notes

- Generators vary truth conclusion, recovery strategy, and `intent_authorized` within fixture constraints.  
- Uses `ProgressionEngine::classify_only` to avoid append side effects during property exploration.

## Result

| Property | Status |
|----------|--------|
| `classification_is_deterministic` | Pass |

## Replay corollary

Identical durable history plus `recover_from_log` reproduces the same record set (covered by `prg_recovery` integration test).
